design.name: gemm_bias_relu_npu
design.description: Synthesizable int8 GEMM with int32 bias add and ReLU activation using streaming tiles.

operations.name: gemm_core
operations.semantics: Compute C[m,n] = sum_{k=0..K-1}(A[m,k]*B[k,n]) with A,B as signed int8 and accumulation in signed int32.

operations.name: bias_add
operations.semantics: Compute Cb[m,n] = C[m,n] + Bias[n], Bias is signed int32 broadcast across M.

operations.name: relu
operations.semantics: Compute Y[m,n] = max(0, Cb[m,n]) in signed int32 domain.

data_types.name: mul_int16
data_types.conversion_semantics: Exact signed multiply of two int8.
data_types.overflow_semantics: No overflow for 8x8 product in 16 bits.

data_types.name: acc_int32
data_types.conversion_semantics: Each int16 product sign-extended to int32 then added.

data_types.name: Y_int32
data_types.conversion_semantics: ReLU output from int32 biased sum.

dimensions.name: M
dimensions.semantic: rows of A and output Y

dimensions.name: N
dimensions.semantic: columns of B and output Y

compute.dataflow: Output-stationary within TILE_M x TILE_N tile across K loop
compute.parallelism: TILE_M*TILE_N parallel int8xint8 MAC lanes each cycle
compute.scheduling: Deterministic nested loops over tile_m, tile_n, k with one MAC step per cycle

storage.name: a_tile_buffer
storage.stores: A tile row elements for current k step
storage.access_pattern: Read all TILE_M each cycle at current k; refill per k/tile.
storage.port_requirements: 1 write path from input stream, TILE_M read fanout via register array
storage.reuse_semantics: Each loaded A value reused across TILE_N MAC lanes in same row for cycle.

storage.name: b_tile_buffer
storage.stores: B tile column elements for current k step
storage.access_pattern: Read all TILE_N each cycle at current k; refill per k/tile.
storage.port_requirements: 1 write path from input stream, TILE_N read fanout via register array
storage.reuse_semantics: Each loaded B value reused across TILE_M MAC lanes in same column for cycle.

storage.name: acc_tile_buffer
storage.stores: Partial sums for TILE_M x TILE_N outputs
storage.access_pattern: Read-modify-write each element every cycle during K accumulation.
storage.port_requirements: Implemented as per-lane registers enabling parallel update of all elements per cycle
storage.reuse_semantics: Retained across full K loop, then consumed by bias/relu/output.

storage.name: bias_buffer
storage.access_pattern: Sequential load once per job; random-access by output column index.
storage.port_requirements: 1 write stream port + up to TILE_N read per cycle via banking/replication
storage.implementation_hint: small SRAM or register file with replication
storage.reuse_semantics: Reused for all M rows of job.

pipeline.responsibility: Latch command and dimensions when accepted.
pipeline.stall_behavior: Holds latched config until job completion.

pipeline.responsibility: Ingest bias and A/B tile elements from input streams.
pipeline.stall_behavior: Backpressures inputs via ready deassertion when buffers full.

pipeline.valid_behavior: One K-step update when operands available.
pipeline.stall_behavior: Freezes k counter and accumulator state.

pipeline.responsibility: Bias add then ReLU per accumulator lane.
pipeline.valid_behavior: Produces TILE_M*TILE_N outputs over sequenced emission.
pipeline.stall_behavior: Holds output payload stable while valid=1 and ready=0.

control.error_behavior: Illegal command (dimension 0 or above max) sets status_error and refuses start until next reset or clear command.

reset.required_state: FSM to IDLE, valids low, ready defaults per IDLE policy, counters zero, error cleared.

architecture_contract.latency_model: Variable latency: setup (bias load) + sum over tiles of (K MAC cycles + load/emit overhead), with additional stalls under backpressure.
architectural_invariants: No output transaction occurs unless corresponding computation complete.
Output order is row-major over M then N.
Transfer condition on streaming channels is ready&&valid only.
Accumulator cleared before each new output tile accumulation.
open_assumptions: A and B provided as streams already ordered for tile scheduler needs.
Bias loaded fully before compute starts.
No quantization/downcast at output; output is int32.
Overflow behavior is two's-complement wrap for int32 accumulation/add.

channels.name: b_in
channels.ordering: Row-major over k then n for B[k][n]

signals.name: status_done
signals.semantic: Pulses high for one cycle when job completes

global_handshake_rules.transfer_condition: A transfer occurs iff ready && valid on that channel.
global_handshake_rules.stall_behavior: While valid=1 and ready=0, payload and sideband remain stable.

modules.name: control_fsm
modules.responsibility: Job sequencing, counters, legality checks, done/error generation.

modules.name: stream_ingress
modules.responsibility: Handshake management and loading of bias/A/B into internal buffers.

modules.name: mac_tile_engine
modules.responsibility: Parallel int8 multiply-accumulate over K into int32 tile accumulators.

modules.name: postproc_emit
modules.responsibility: Bias add, ReLU, and ordered y_out streaming.

functional: For any legal M,N,K and inputs, output Y equals ReLU(AxB + Bias) with exact integer arithmetic and two's-complement wrap in int32 accumulation/add.
Output sequence is exactly row-major over m then n.
Bias is applied per output column n to every row m.
verification: Minimum 100 randomized legal transactions across varied M,N,K including boundary cases 1 and 64.
Reset tests verify deterministic return to IDLE, cleared valids/status_done low/status_error low.
Backpressure tests on all ready/valid channels verify no loss/duplication and stable payload under stall.
Directed tests for illegal cmd values (0 or >max) verify status_error behavior and no output emission.
rtl: RTL is SystemVerilog synthesizable-only and excludes forbidden constructs: real, shortreal, delay statements, force/release, classes.
No combinational ready/valid loops causing non-synthesizable behavior.
All counters and index widths support configured bounds without overflow in addressing/control.
synopsys_handoff: Provide deterministic Synopsys synthesis report conforming to multigent/schemas/synthesis_result.schema.json.
Report generation only after verification pass; no estimated or inferred metrics accepted.
All reported PPA/timing/utilization values must come from authoritative deterministic tool report.
